summary: Phases 01-03 fully match plan.md: every planned file, promised test, and boundary contract was confirmed present with no unplanned changes anywhere in the run. Phase-04 delivered its README, hello-world example script, config registration, and example-provider tests exactly as specified, but never edited .claude/skills/phax-planning/SKILL.md as the plan required -- the file still documents four lint checks and omits the new advisory check entirely. The phase-04 handoff discloses this gap honestly (an Edit permission for that path was denied twice, with no further attempt), which is why the run is conformant-with-deviations rather than divergent, but the plan's objective for that file remains unmet in the shipped state.

The handoff explicitly and specifically discloses the SKILL.md gap, its cause, and what a follow-up must do -- a well-formed disclosure even though the underlying deviation remains unresolved in the shipped state.
